/** Dados e callbacks do quadro; nenhuma referência à fase é entregue ao desenho. */
export function createToyRoomSceneFrame(room) {
  return {
    ROOM_H: room.ROOM_H,
    ROOM_W: room.ROOM_W,
    actionBtnPressed: room.actionBtnPressed,
    assets: room.assets,
    cameraX: room.cameraX,
    cameraY: room.cameraY,
    canInteract: room.canInteract,
    canvas: room.canvas,
    confetti: room.confetti,
    ctx: room.ctx,
    environmentChest: room.environmentChest,
    environmentDetails: room.environmentDetails,
    environmentDoor: room.environmentDoor,
    environmentFloorTile: room.environmentFloorTile,
    environmentRug: room.environmentRug,
    environmentTable: room.environmentTable,
    environmentTeddy: room.environmentTeddy,
    environmentTrain: room.environmentTrain,
    fairy: room.fairy,
    footstepPuffs: room.footstepPuffs,
    furniture: room.furniture,
    getCameraFrame: () => room.getCameraFrame(),
    introAlpha: room.introAlpha,
    introBannerTimer: room.introBannerTimer,
    isNearChest: room.isNearChest,
    isTouchDevice: room.isTouchDevice,
    organizedCount: room.organizedCount,
    player: room.player,
    sparkles: room.sparkles,
    story: room.story,
    sunMotes: room.sunMotes,
    touchState: room.touchState,
    toys: room.toys,
    tutorial: room.tutorial,
    victoryBannerActive: room.victoryBannerActive,
    victoryBannerTimer: room.victoryBannerTimer,
  };
}
